blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Malacañang on Tuesday rejected claims by fugitive Sen. Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa’s wife that he was being persecuted, saying he should not hide if his conscience was clear. Palace Press Officer Claire Castro said the senator’s possible arrest was not an act of persecution, noting that complaints against him had been pending for years. “We will not comment on the feelings of Sen. Bato dela Rosa’s wife because we respect her situation,” she said in a Viber message to reporters. “However, her claim that Sen.
